A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DyGMamba research. Their complete text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices support comparison, including matching relocated limitations and discrete-time graph experiments.

before.justification: V3 reports original link-prediction experiments, synthetic-data evaluations, ablations, efficiency measurements, and dynamic node-classification results.

after.justification: V4 retains these empirical results and adds feature ablations, a modified DyGFormer comparison, historical-neighbor statistics, and a neighbor-count experiment.

M1.justification: The proposed node-level and time-level SSMs, temporal-pattern selection, feature encoding, patching, prediction procedure, and training loss remain unchanged. The new variants are experimental controls, not revisions to DyGMamba.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same seven CTDG datasets, six DTDG datasets, synthetic datasets S1–S3, and Wikipedia/Reddit node-classification tasks. The added analyses reuse this coverage; changing sampled-neighbor counts does not introduce a new task or population.

E2.justification: V4 adds Variant G, a DyGFormer with its Transformer replaced by Mamba, as an evaluated comparator in Table 24. The original ten baseline methods remain, and FreeDyG still has no reported comparison results.

E3.justification: V4 introduces feature-removal and backbone-replacement controls and a Can. Parl neighbor-count sweep from 64 to 2048 under transductive link prediction with random negative sampling. Existing splits, metrics, training budgets, and benchmark configurations remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Diagnostic validation expands substantially. Tables 3–4 add ablations removing time features and interaction-frequency features. Appendix L adds historical-neighbor availability analysis, a Can. Parl sensitivity study, and Variant G to test whether simply substituting Mamba for Transformer explains the benefits. Existing component, synthetic-pattern, and patch-size analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions state five runs with five random seeds and retain the same mean/error-bar reporting practice. New point-estimate tables follow existing ablation reporting; no new confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty-estimation procedures are introduced.

E6.justification: Original benchmark results remain, but v4 adds substantial diagnostic results and Reddit/Social Evo. efficiency measurements. New LastFM transductive/random AP values are 85.80 and 87.47 for Variants E and F, versus retained DyGMamba AP 93.35. Table 23 reports Can. Parl scores from 72.58 to 99.57 as neighbors increase. Table 24 adds Variant G results and introduces an S1 inconsistency: 81.85 for DyGMamba versus retained 81.58 in Table 5.

T1.justification: The graph/task definitions, SSM mathematics, model equations, loss, and complexity expressions are unchanged. The added motivation and mechanism discussion introduces no new formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: introducing SSMs for CTDG representation learning, selecting information through temporal patterns, and achieving strong prediction performance with efficient long-history modeling.

C2.justification: New Section 5 and Appendix L substantially expand interpretation: they identify sparse historical context as a possible failure condition, justify restricting the model to one-hop neighbors, and attribute Variant G's weakness partly to Mamba's copying limitations. The existing limitation concerning concurrent DTDG edges is moved into Section 7, not newly discovered.

D1.justification: V4 adds an explicit DyGMamba code-repository address in the abstract footnote. V3 provides baseline and Mamba-library addresses but no corresponding DyGMamba access information. Existing Appendix C implementation and hyperparameter details are retained.

R1.justification: V4 expands comparisons with existing static-graph and spatial-temporal Mamba approaches and adds references to Shirzadkhani et al., Han et al., and Waleffe et al. These refine contextual positioning without changing the principal novelty claim.

P1.justification: V4 adds a Discussion section and motivation appendix, moves limitations into the main text, expands related-work explanations, and updates author presentation, publication headers, and acknowledgements. Most existing methodological and experimental prose remains intact.

P2.justification: V4 expands Tables 3–4 and 15–16, adds Tables 22–24 and an efficiency Figure 6, reformats Table 5, and widens Figure 4 without changing its values. Other figures are retained or renumbered, with publication-format changes to the title page and headers.

improvement.justification: The added controls strengthen assessment of feature contributions and the benefit beyond simply adopting Mamba, while Section 5 clarifies applicability and the code address improves reproducibility information. These gains are tempered by new reporting inconsistencies: DyGMamba's Reddit per-epoch time is 6.30 minutes in Table 15 but 3.32 in Table 16, and Tables 5 and 24 disagree on S1 performance. The retained main evidence remains intact, supporting a limited net improvement.
